note: Real outbound customs records exist with dates, destinations (Oman, UAE), HS 94054200 and B/L numbers, so export activity is confirmed, not merely claimed. However, the declared HS codes in the batch (400829; 720917; 731811; 731815 — rubber/metal profiles, screws, bolts) do not match the observed trade: actual records are lighting fixtures and LED components under HS 9405/8541. Per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground — the company stays in the base and the HS code should be corrected to the factual one (94054200 / 9405 family, with 8541 for LED components). The claimed industry "Авиастроение и транспорт" (aerospace & transport) is also unsupported by the shipment data, which is architectural/industrial lighting. Note the address on record is Jigani, Karnataka, not the claimed Tamil Nadu. Revenue and export volume figures: null — not public in retrieved sources. Second-source corroboration failed: volza.com, eximpedia.app, trademo.com and importgenius.com all returned HTTP 403 / JS challenge, and web_search was unavailable (connection refused), so the export finding rests on a single free-view source with only 2 visible outbound rows out of 4309 claimed. Domestic supply traces: no GST turnover, tender or contract evidence found — status declared_only on the basis of manufacturing inputs and registered premises only.
